name: device-fatiha-full
notes: THE FIRST REAL CAPTURE. Al-Fatiha 1:1-1:7 recited straight through on a physical Android phone (2026-08-26), exported from the summary card. Raw android.speech.SpeechRecognizer output, unedited apart from the name and these notes. Three things in it are the reason it is worth keeping: (1) the recognizer cut the session into three segments, so the transcript restarts from empty twice mid-surah; (2) segment 2 opens with 'الرحمن الرحيم', which is also in 1:1 four words back, and must resolve to 1:3 rather than dragging the cursor backwards; (3) segment 3 opens by repeating 'الدين', a word already consumed, which must neither move the cursor back nor be flagged as a mistake.
